findings.current: {computer} पर Local Operator पर ध्यान देने की ज़रूरत है।

code_findings_outside_catalogue_verdict.suggested: Localize the fallback via a catalogue key. code_findings_outside_catalogue_verdict.reason: Rendered all 13 {computer} titles with the repo's formatMessage for 'Damian का MacBook', 'Your computer', 'आपका कंप्यूटर' (check.out). Catalogue templates are grammatical for names/URLs/Latin text; the defect is the untranslated code literal and the case trap any single translated fallback would hit.
